nodes.description: mapping(address => uint256) private _balances in ERC20 storing token balances
mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) private _allowances in ERC20 storing spend approvals
uint256 private _totalSupply tracking minted/burned token supply
string private _name token name set in ERC20 constructor
string private _symbol token symbol set in ERC20 constructor
uint8 immutable private _decimals in ERC20Decimals, set once at construction
msg.sender, attacker-controlled caller address returned by Context._msgSender and used as the mint recipient
StandardERC20 constructor: payable, validates initialBalance_ > 0, calls ServicePayer/ERC20/ERC20Decimals constructors and mints initial supply to _msgSender()
ServicePayer payable constructor performing the external call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName)
internal _mint(address account, uint256 amount): increases _totalSupply and _balances[account] and emits Transfer
internal _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount): validates balances and moves tokens
public transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) delegating to _transfer(_msgSender(), ...)
public transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount): moves tokens and reduces allowance
public approve(address spender, uint256 amount) delegating to _approve(_msgSender(), spender, amount)
internal _approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount): writes _allowances and emits Approval
Context._msgSender() returning msg.sender, the identity source for the mint recipient
public increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue): adds to existing allowance
public decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue): subtracts from existing allowance after a require check
internal _burn(address account, uint256 amount): reduces _balances[account] and _totalSupply
public balanceOf(address account) reading _balances[account]
public allowance(address owner, address spender) reading _allowances[owner][spender]
public totalSupply() reading _totalSupply
public name() returning _name
public symbol() returning _symbol
public decimals() overridden in ERC20Decimals/StandardERC20 returning _decimals
internal virtual _beforeTokenTransfer hook invoked by _transfer, _mint and _burn (empty implementation)
unsafe external payable call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) made in the ServicePayer constructor to an arbitrary receiver-supplied contract
unsafe arithmetic _balances[account] += amount inside _mint
unsafe arithmetic _balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount inside _transfer
unsafe arithmetic _totalSupply += amount inside _mint
unsafe arithmetic _allowances[_msgSender()][spender] + addedValue inside increaseAllowance
unsafe arithmetic allowance subtractions currentAllowance - subtractedValue (decreaseAllowance) and currentAllowance - amount (transferFrom)
